name: Convex-Geometry Ideals Are Conditional Antimatroids
scope: Finite one-inclusion graphs, up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants.
statement: Signed convex-geometry ideals are a proper subclass of signed bouquets (conditional-antimatroid graph classes).
proof: Ideals inherit intersection closure and ampleness. The existing 26-set bouquet is not affine-convex realizable, while every signed convex-geometry ideal is realizable, so it has no ideal presentation in any orientation.
comments: The new nonrealizable witness establishes strictness for signed-coordinate graph classes, strengthening the older oriented-family inclusion.
